mapper.select: SELECT pio.id, pio.inbound_no, pio.return_type, pio.ref_no, pio.erp_tenant_id, pio.shipping_order_id, so.shipping_no AS shipping_order_no, pio.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, pio.inbound_date, pio.order_status, pio.remark, pio.create_by, su.nickname AS create_by_name, pio.create_time FROM wms_purchase_inbound_order pio LEFT JOIN wms_shipping_order so ON pio.shipping_order_id = so.id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON pio.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON pio.create_by = su.user_id WHERE pio.id = #{id} AND pio.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM wms_purchase_inbound_order WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM wms_purchase_inbound_order WHERE UPPER(inbound_no) = UPPER(#{inboundNo}) AND order_status = 'SUBMITTED' AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT soi.id AS shipping_order_item_id, soi.purchase_order_id, po.order_no AS purchase_order_no, soi.purchase_order_item_id, soi.sku_code, soi.quantity AS shipped_quantity, soi.received_quantity, (soi.quantity - soi.received_quantity - soi.inbound_reserved_quantity) AS pending_quantity, po.expected_delivery_date FROM wms_shipping_order_item soi INNER JOIN wms_purchase_order po ON soi.purchase_order_id = po.id WHERE soi.shipping_order_id = #{shippingOrderId} AND soi.quantity > soi.received_quantity + soi.inbound_reserved_quantity ORDER BY po.expected_delivery_date ASC, po.order_no ASC, soi.id ASC

SELECT pio.id, pio.inbound_no, pio.warehouse_id, pio.inbound_date, pio.order_status FROM wms_purchase_inbound_order pio WHERE pio.shipping_order_id = #{shippingOrderId} AND pio.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pio.create_time DESC
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM wms_purchase_inbound_order WHERE shipping_order_id = #{shippingOrderId} AND order_status IN ('RECEIVED', 'COMPLETED') AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 )
